headings: Return Handling by Response Type per Item
text: The status for the return will be approved. For item(s) to replace Company creates an order charged to the selected credit card for the replacement items configured on the return. Customer sends the original item(s) back. Company receives the items and processes them. Company sees that the replacement has already been sent and sets the return status to complete. Company credits amount charged for the replacement back to credit card selected for return. For refund after a return for replacement use payment transaction info from original order even though order attached directly to the return is a zero amount order.
